svg.title: FinAware — The Three Machine-Learning Models
svg.text: Each model is trained offline from a fixed dataset, saved as files, loaded by the ML service when it starts, and asked for answers by the Financial API while the app runs. The recommendations themselves are rules, not a model.
OFFLINE — trained by npm run ml:models (about 10 minutes), results committed as files

When a model file is missing

The risk model is required: without it /health/ready answers 503 and every risk request gets 503 MODEL_UNAVAILABLE, so nothing is stored. The missed-payment and peer-group files are optional: without them only
their own endpoint answers 503 and everything else works.
Other errors: 422 INVALID_INPUT (a value out of range, or a loan with has_loan = No) · 500 PREDICTION_FAILED
GET /model-info → the About the models page (the model card)

Names, versions, training dates, test results, the risk score formula, the explanation method and the risk target's status — read from the same metadata files the models were saved with. Never the model files themselves.
